title: Candy Metric1 Field Completeness Score
dataSources: Festive lights (`festive:lights`), candy counter (`candy:counter`), countdown events (`countdown:event`), Santa tracker (`santa:tracker`).
app: Seasonal novelty feeds — smart Christmas-light power meters, a Halloween candy counter, advent/holiday countdowns, and festive trackers — streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and smart plugs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=candy:metric1
| eval complete=if(isnotnull(value) AND isnotnull(duration_min),1,0)
| stats sum(complete) as complete_rows, count as total
| eval completeness_pct=round(100*complete_rows/total,1)
description: Measures how often candy metric1 (1) events include both value and duration.
value: Incomplete exports break joins and dashboards; completeness scoring catches schema drift early.
implementation: Require `value` and `duration_min` on candy metric1 (1) events and track completeness percentage.
visualization: Single-value gauge of field completeness percent.
grandmaExplanation: It catches how often your candy metric1 (1) exports arrive with the key numbers filled in.
